featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Anil Chakravarthy? The Bengaluru Boy Who Became a Chancellor's Gold Medalist, an MIT PhD, a Silicon Valley CEO — and Now Adobe's Next Leader
editorial.excerpt: Adobe's board has named Anil Chakravarthy as its next president and CEO, making him the second consecutive Indian-origin leader at the helm of the creative software giant. His journey from Basavanagudi to the C-suite is a story of quiet, methodical ambition.
editorial.image_caption: Anil Chakravarthy, who has been named Adobe's next CEO effective December 1, 2026, succeeding Shantanu Narayen.
editorial.nri_angle: Adobe's CEO succession from one Indian-origin leader to another underscores the growing dominance of Indian-educated executives in global tech leadership.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: US Envoy Sergio Gor: India Relationship Stronger Than Five Years Ago
just_in.excerpt: In an interview with India Today, US Ambassador Sergio Gor argues the strategic partnership has deepened across trade, defence and technology — and says the interim trade deal is effectively done.
just_in.image_caption: US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor. The envoy told India Today that the US-India relationship is 'stronger than it was five years ago,' pointing to deeper cooperation on trade, defence and technology.
just_in.nri_angle: Gor's reassurance that the H-1B review is a broad overhaul rather than India-targeted speaks directly to the hundreds of thousands of Indian professionals on US work visas.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Valuation in Sequoia-Led Round for Robot Training Data
just_in.excerpt: The humanoid data startup would be valued at roughly five times its last round just three months ago, as investors race to own the physical-world datasets behind general-purpose robots.
just_in.image_caption: A humanoid robot. Mecka AI, backed by Sequoia, is nearing a $500 million valuation to build training data for robots.
just_in.nri_angle: The deal lands in a sector where Indian-origin engineers and researchers are already deeply embedded — at AI labs, robotics companies, and data platforms expanding into physical AI.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Mirzapur The Movie Crosses $2 Million In North America, Climbing Indian Box Office Charts
just_in.excerpt: The crime thriller took ₹9.5 crore on its second Friday to reach ₹163.27 crore net in India, overtaking Awarapan 2 for the year's No. 6 spot, while its $2.05 million North American haul made it the fourth Bollywood film of 2026 to cross $2 million in the territory.
just_in.nri_angle: Mirzapur The Movie's $2.05 million North American first week — Bollywood's fourth $2M grosser of 2026 — shows how diaspora demand for established Indian series IPs converts directly into overseas box office.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: IRCTC Shatters Records as 20 Lakh Tickets Booked in a Single Day
just_in.excerpt: The September 7 milestone marks the first time India's online railway ticketing platform has crossed the 20-lakh single-day mark, with upgraded servers and anti-bot measures keeping the system stable through the Diwali booking rush.
just_in.image_caption: Second seating inside an Indian Railways coach. IRCTC set a record with over 20 lakh tickets booked in a single day.
just_in.nri_angle: NRIs planning Diwali travel to India should book now: the 60-day advance reservation window concentrates festive demand, and Aadhaar verification is compulsory for individual users booking when the window opens.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian man jailed 27 years in Australia for fatal stabbing, faces deportation
just_in.excerpt: Robin Robin, 30, was sentenced in the Victorian Supreme Court for murdering 22-year-old Navjeet Singh Sandhu and attempting to murder Sharwan Singh during a drunken rampage in Ormond in May 2024. He will not be eligible for parole for 20 years and is expected to be deported to India.
just_in.image_caption: Melbourne, where the Victorian Supreme Court sentenced Robin Robin to 27 years in prison for a fatal stabbing in Ormond.
just_in.nri_angle: The sentencing shows how a serious criminal conviction in Australia leads to visa cancellation and post-sentence deportation for Indian nationals, a direct warning for the large Indian student and migrant community.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: At 4, Treesha Thosar Breaks Kamal Haasan's Record as Youngest National Award Winner
just_in.excerpt: Treesha Vivek Thosar received the Best Child Artist honour at the 71st National Film Awards for her role as Chimi in the Marathi film Naal 2, surpassing a record Kamal Haasan had held since 1960.

Bollywood Hungama — Kamal Haasan congratulates Treesha Thosar

just_in.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, a four-year-old Marathi actor setting a national record is a point of cultural pride and a way for diaspora families to celebrate Indian cinema's young talent with their own children.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Trezor Brevo Breach Exposed 347,000 Emails to Phishing Attack
just_in.excerpt: A flaw in email provider Brevo's login system let attackers send phishing emails from Trezor's own domain to 347,000 newsletter subscribers — the hardware wallet maker's second third-party data breach in weeks.
just_in.nri_angle: Crypto ownership runs deep in the Indian diaspora, so wallet-holding readers should scrutinize vendor-branded emails and warn family members about the phishing campaign.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Mumbai's Lalbaugcha Raja Food Waste to Power Civic Hospitals During Ganeshotsav
just_in.excerpt: Under BMC's 'Prasad to Power' plan, 8–10 tonnes of wet waste from Mumbai's most famous Ganesh pandal will be converted into electricity for municipal hospitals across the 11-day festival.
just_in.image_caption: Mumbai's Lalbaugcha Raja Ganesh idol. Food waste collected during the festival will power civic hospitals.
just_in.nri_angle: The initiative pairs faith with sustainability at one of the diaspora's most-watched festivals, giving NRIs who follow Ganeshotsav from Mumbai's celebrations a tangible example of Indian cities linking devotion to environmental responsibility.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: DHS Moves to Scrap 60-Day Grace Period for H-1B Workers After Job Loss
just_in.excerpt: A proposed DHS rule scheduled for publication Sept. 11, 2026 would eliminate the post-employment grace period for H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN and other work-visa holders — forcing laid-off workers to leave the U.S. almost immediately or face deportation proceedings.
just_in.image_caption: The Department of Homeland Security headquarters. DHS is moving to scrap the 60-day grace period for H-1B workers after job loss.
just_in.nri_angle: H-1B workers — the overwhelming majority of grace-period users — would lose the post-layoff cushion relied on by many Indian professionals in the U.S. tech sector.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Finland Courts Indian Students With Work Rights, Family Visas and Affordable Tuition
just_in.excerpt: As the US, UK, Canada and Australia tighten student rules, Finland is pitching Indian students a steadier deal: 30 hours of weekly work during study, a two-year post-study job search, and family residence permits. Here is what the numbers actually say.
just_in.image_caption: The University of Helsinki. Finland is courting Indian students with work rights, family visas, and affordable tuition.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian families get a rare combination — generous student work rights, a two-year post-study job search, and family residence permits — but must weigh tuition costs against a proposed 2027 family-reunification waiting period.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Divyanshi Choudhary Breaks Down After Last-Minute Asian Games Wushu Axing
just_in.excerpt: The 18-year-old wushu player beat Roshibina Devi in the selection trials and had already collected her India kit for Aichi-Nagoya — then was dropped days before departure, citing a knee injury her camp calls treatable.
just_in.image_caption: A wushu competition. Divyanshi Choudhary broke down after her event was axed from the Asian Games at the last minute.
just_in.nri_angle: Selection transparency and athlete welfare in Indian sports — a governance issue diaspora fans follow closely as India chases medals beyond cricket at the Asian Games.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Drooping smile, weak arms: neurologists flag stroke warning signs in young adults
just_in.excerpt: A drooping smile, a weak arm and slurred speech are the classic red flags — and with four in ten Indian stroke patients now under 50, neurologists say young adults should learn the BEFAST checklist and act within the golden hours.
just_in.image_caption: Brain scans. Neurologists warn that a drooping smile, weak arms, and slurred speech can signal a stroke.

sources.label: Passionate in Marketing / World Stroke Day

just_in.nri_angle: South Asians develop cardiovascular risk factors earlier and at higher rates, making BEFAST stroke awareness especially relevant in NRI households — and for spotting warning signs in ageing parents back home.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Microlot coffee: Inside India's limited-edition world of specialty brews
just_in.excerpt: From Tata Coffee's Nullore Estate at the Starbucks Reserve Roastery to yeast-washed lots from Ratnagiri, India's microlots — tiny, experimental, estate-separated batches — are winning global awards and selling out in small runs.
just_in.image_caption: Freshly roasted specialty coffee beans. India's microlot scene is bringing limited-edition brews from estates in Coorg and Chikmagalur to urban cafes.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian specialty coffees are increasingly available through online roasters and premium cafes abroad, giving diaspora drinkers a traceable, estate-level cup from Coorg and Chikmagalur.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Sardar 2 opens at Rs 5.30 crore, loses domestic battle to Soori's Mandaadi
just_in.excerpt: Karthi's Sardar 2 grossed Rs 5.30 crore in India on opening day but was out-earned at home by the much smaller Soori-starrer Mandaadi, which managed Rs 5.55 crore on nearly 1,000 fewer shows. Overseas business gave the sequel a narrow worldwide lead.
just_in.image_caption: Karthi, who stars in Sardar 2. The film opened at Rs 5.30 crore domestically, trailing Soori's Mandaadi in its first week.
just_in.nri_angle: Overseas business was the one front where Sardar 2 led on day one, with Tamil diaspora audiences in the Gulf, Malaysia and Singapore turning out for Karthi's sequel.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Toxic week 2: Yash's film crawls to Rs 263 crore as 300-crore flop looms
just_in.excerpt: Yash's Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups added just Rs 6.75 crore in its second weekend, taking its 12-day India gross to Rs 263 crore. Trade trackers say the costly film is headed for one of the biggest losses in Indian cinema.
just_in.image_caption: A still from Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, showing Yash and Kiara Advani. The Geethu Mohandas-directed film reached Rs 263 crore gross in India after 12 days and is expected to finish its run under Rs 270 crore.
just_in.nri_angle: The film's English version, aimed partly at overseas multiplex audiences, was pulled after a week, and the theatrical collapse leaves the digital premiere as diaspora viewers' main route to the film.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: After Talks Until 4 AM, BRICS Reaches Consensus With India's Help
news.excerpt: Negotiators hammered out a joint declaration condemning unilateral war after all-night consultations led by India, bridging deep divisions between Iran and the UAE over the Gulf conflict.
news.nri_angle: The UAE and Saudi Arabia are among the largest destinations for Indian workers abroad, so India's role in bridging the Iran-UAE divide directly protects the diaspora's jobs, remittance corridors, and travel routes.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Iran Pushes for BRICS Bank Membership as Araghchi Calls Modi Talks 'Strong'
news.excerpt: On the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, Iran's foreign minister said Tehran is “working on” New Development Bank membership, with some countries already supportive.
news.image_caption: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi. He called his talks with Prime Minister Modi 'strong' as Iran pushes for BRICS bank membership.
news.nri_angle: A deeper India-Iran economic partnership, via Chabahar and local-currency trade, matters to Indian businesses and diaspora professionals engaged in Gulf and West Asia commerce.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Xi's Mystery Black-Covered Limousine Lands in Delhi Ahead of BRICS Summit
news.excerpt: The Hongqi N701, China's secretive presidential limousine, arrived under covers for Xi Jinping's first India visit in seven years, with Modi set to host him on Saturday evening.
news.image_caption: Chinese President Xi Jinping. His black-covered limousine drew attention as he landed in Delhi for the BRICS summit.
news.nri_angle: The summit's outcomes on trade, currency settlement, and India-China ties will shape the economic environment that Indian businesses and professionals operate in.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Full Itinerary, Timings and What to Watch in New Delhi
news.excerpt: Leaders of the expanded 11-member bloc converge on Bharat Mandapam on September 12–13, with the BRICS Business Forum opening today and traffic restrictions across central Delhi.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks at a public address, with Indian national flags displayed behind him. Modi hosts the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on September 12–13 as India holds the grouping’s 2026 chairship.
news.nri_angle: Summit decisions on cross-border payments, national-currency settlement and digital trade set the infrastructure for cheaper remittances and more competitive Indian exporters — and mark India's bid to be a global-economic rule-maker.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Russian drones kill 2 at Ukraine-Moldova border crossing; Zelenskyy demands global action
news.excerpt: Moscow's drones struck the Starokozache crossing in Odesa region and renewed attacks on Kyiv, a day after Russian drones violated Moldovan airspace and delayed Zelenskyy's flight to Norway.
news.image_caption: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrives at an airport, greeted by officials. Zelenskyy called for global action after Russian drones killed two people at a Ukraine-Moldova border crossing.
news.nri_angle: Prolonged disruption of Black Sea and overland trade routes keeps upward pressure on global crude and freight costs felt by NRIs, while the safety of Indians still in Ukraine is a recurring concern.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: 'More or less' finalised: commerce secretary says India-US trade deal nears signing
news.excerpt: Rajesh Agrawal said the two sides are working on a framework for preferential market access bridging India's MFN tariffs and US executive tariffs, with signing to follow at an 'appropriate time.'
news.image_caption: A container ship being loaded at Jawaharlal Nehru Port near Mumbai, India's largest container port. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the India-US trade deal has been 'more or less' finalised.
news.nri_angle: Indian-American businesses and exporters stand to gain preferential US market access, while NRIs could benefit if fintech-driven remittance costs fall as the commerce secretary envisions.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Pakistan rules out immediate military action under Mecca pact after Houthi attacks
news.excerpt: Islamabad says no military response is under discussion following Houthi strikes on Saudi cities and energy infrastructure, but pledges it will act under the trilateral defence pact 'when time comes.'
news.image_caption: The Great Mosque of Mecca. Pakistan says no military response is currently being discussed under the Mecca defence pact it signed with Turkey and Saudi Arabia.
news.nri_angle: Millions of Indians live and work in Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf; any widening of the conflict threatens their safety and remittance flows, while crude price spikes feed India's import bill.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Rights groups condemn 'racist murder' of Manipuri singer in Delhi, demand racial-motive probe
news.excerpt: Civil society and human rights organisations say the mob killing of musician Chongtham Vikram Singh must be examined in the wider context of racial violence against people from Northeast India.
news.image_caption: A candle-lighting vigil for Chongtham Vikram, the 55-year-old Manipuri guitarist killed in Delhi. Rights groups have condemned his murder as racially motivated.
news.nri_angle: For the Northeastern diaspora abroad, the case is a measure of how India confronts racial violence at home, shaping how safe the community feels in Indian cities.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia as 'Unacceptable' Threat to Region
news.excerpt: New Delhi denounced Houthi strikes on Saudi civilian and economic sites that injured 73 people, warning the escalation threatens regional stability and freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb.
news.image_caption: MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal speaks at a press briefing in New Delhi. India condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's civilian and economic infrastructure, which injured 73 people, as unacceptable.
news.nri_angle: Saudi Arabia hosts one of the largest Indian expatriate communities in the world, and attacks on its oil infrastructure feed directly into crude prices that shape inflation in India.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Lancet Study: Passive Smoking Deaths in India Jump 50% Since 1990
news.excerpt: Deaths from second-hand smoke in India rose from about 217,700 to 325,600 between 1990 and 2023, with 444 million Indians now exposed — the world's second-highest total after China.
news.image_caption: A smoker exhales a cloud of cigarette smoke. A Lancet study finds passive-smoking deaths in India have jumped 50 percent since 1990.
news.nri_angle: The findings matter for Indian-American multi-generational households, where grandparents visiting from India may smoke indoors and children face the greatest health burden from second-hand exposure.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Bangladesh Rules Out PM Tarique Rahman's Attendance at Delhi BRICS Summit
news.excerpt: Dhaka says the BRICS invitation was extended to the BIMSTEC chair, not to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman personally, and insists his first India visit cannot be a multilateral one.
news.image_caption: Tarique Rahman presiding over a National Economic Council meeting in Dhaka. Bangladesh has ruled out the prime minister's attendance at the BRICS summit in New Delhi.
news.nri_angle: The India-Bangladesh relationship is watched closely by the Bangladeshi diaspora and Indian-Americans with ties across the border; the first Rahman-Modi meeting will set the tone for trade and border issues affecting millions.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: China Confirms Xi to Visit India for First Time in Seven Years
news.excerpt: President Xi Jinping will attend the BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, with bilateral talks and a trade-minister meeting set amid record trade and a record deficit.
news.nri_angle: Indian-American and global Indian business professionals face practical stakes in the visit, from supply-chain and investment rules to visas and trade finance.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India, Russia Expand Talks on Building 105 Regional Aircraft Ahead of BRICS
news.excerpt: Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu says New Delhi and Moscow have widened talks on manufacturing the IL-114 turboprop and Sukhoi Superjet 100 in India, targeting the UDAN regional connectivity push.
news.image_caption: Indian and Russian officials at a signing ceremony with both countries' flags on the table. India and Russia are expanding talks on building 105 regional aircraft ahead of the BRICS summit.
news.nri_angle: Primarily a domestic aviation and manufacturing story; it matters for NRIs who fly India's expanding regional routes and for the diaspora watching India's industrial ambitions.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Virtual Trade Corridors Could Deepen BRICS Connectivity, Says RITES Chief
news.excerpt: RITES CMD Rahul Mithal told the BRICS Roundtable that India's MAITRI platform could seed a digital trade network across the bloc — a starting point for the Bharat Trade Net vision.
news.nri_angle: A domestic trade-infrastructure story; relevant to NRIs in logistics, shipping and trade, and to the diaspora watching India's BRICS chairmanship.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Hosts BRICS Summit as Iran War Divides the Bloc's Newest Members
news.excerpt: Leaders from 11 BRICS nations gather in New Delhi on September 12-13, with the U.S.-led war on Iran - pitting Iran against fellow member UAE - testing the bloc's ability to issue a joint declaration.
news.nri_angle: Millions of Indian workers in the UAE and Gulf face direct exposure to the regional escalation, while crude above $100 a barrel hits India's import bill and the purchasing power of remittances - and the summit tests the strategic-autonomy leadership the diaspora watches closely.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: CEPI Gives Pune's Immunoscript $8.9M for Freezer-Free RNA Vaccines
news.excerpt: The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations will fund Pune-based Immunoscript Life Science with up to $8.9 million to advance clinical testing of its thermostable self-amplifying RNA vaccine platform — a key piece of the global '100 Days Mission' to prepare for Disease X.
news.image_caption: Dr Sanjay Singh, founder and chief executive of Immunoscript Life Science. CEPI has committed up to $8.9 million to the Pune company for clinical testing of its freezer-free RNA vaccine platform.
news.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — many of whom flew relatives home for COVID shots or funded vaccine drives — a thermostable RNA platform built in India could one day mean outbreak response that reaches grandparents in villages as fast as it reaches cities.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India to Pitch RBI-Backed Digital Currency Link for BRICS Payments at Summit
news.excerpt: New Delhi will push its proposal to link BRICS central bank digital currencies at the leaders' summit on September 12-13, according to Reuters — but low adoption and political frictions cloud its prospects.
news.image_caption: The flags of Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, the founding members of the BRICS bloc. India will push a proposal to link the bloc's central bank digital currencies for cross-border payments at the leaders' summit in New Delhi on September 12-13.
news.nri_angle: A working CBDC link could lower cross-border payment costs for Indian workers in the Gulf and give Indian exporters a non-dollar settlement rail.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Objects to UN Map Depicting Arunachal, Aksai Chin as Separate Regions
news.excerpt: New Delhi has engaged UN authorities over a world map showing Arunachal Pradesh and Aksai Chin as separate regions, insisting its vote for the 'Correct the Map' resolution endorsed no border claims.
news.nri_angle: Standard UN maps shape textbooks and digital platforms worldwide, so India's challenge aims to stop an inaccurate depiction of its borders from becoming the default the next generation sees.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Bengaluru Techie's Website Reunites Nepal Flood Victims' Families With Data
nri-world.excerpt: ReuniteIndia.com consolidates scattered official records into a single searchable database of people missing in the Nepal floods, with QR-coded live case pages.
nri-world.image_caption: Flood-hit areas in Nepal. A Bengaluru techie's website has been reuniting families separated by the flooding.
nri-world.nri_angle: Many of the missing are Telangana-origin NRIs and Kailash pilgrims, making a single verified English-language database vital for diaspora families searching from abroad.

nri-world.title: Stalker Kills Sacramento Woman Despite Restraining Order; Mother Blames System
nri-world.excerpt: Shalini Thakur, 38, was shot outside a Panera Bread in Sacramento after months of alleged stalking by 22-year-old Rohit Rohit, who later died by suicide in a police standoff.
nri-world.image_caption: Downtown Sacramento. A woman was killed by a stalker despite a restraining order, prompting questions about enforcement gaps.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian-origin woman working a service job in California was killed by her alleged stalker despite a restraining order, raising urgent safety questions for immigrant workers in the diaspora.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Kerala Crash Kills NRI Family of Three; 36-Hour Arrest Delay Raises Questions
nri-world.excerpt: The deaths of Gulf returnee Muneer, his wife and their 3-year-old son have revived questions about delayed alcohol evidence — echoing the 2019 Venkitaraman case.
nri-world.image_caption: A national highway in Kerala. Gulf returnee Muneer, 35, his wife Shafna, 25, and their 3-year-old son died on the Kunnamkulam–Guruvayur road when a car rammed their motorcycle late on September 5.
nri-world.nri_angle: Muneer was a Gulf returnee — his death resonates across Kerala's diaspora, where nearly every family has someone working abroad.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Eiffel Tower Gender Row Over BAPS Visit Unites French Politicians, Splits Diaspora
nri-world.excerpt: A private BAPS visit to the Eiffel Tower that sidelined female staff united French politicians across the spectrum — while splitting the Indian diaspora over accountability and backlash.
nri-world.image_caption: The Eiffel Tower in Paris. A row over a BAPS visit to the monument has united French politicians while splitting opinion in the diaspora.
nri-world.nri_angle: The row has split Indians in France between those warning against anti-Hindu backlash and those insisting BAPS must be held accountable without conflating it with Hinduism.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Bank of America Pilots Zelle-UPI Bridge to Speed NRI Remittances to India
nri-world.excerpt: Bank of America and Early Warning Services are piloting a link between the US instant-payment network Zelle and India's UPI, promising faster, cheaper remittances for NRIs — though the service is not yet publicly available.
nri-world.image_caption: Bank of America signage on a glass office building. The bank is working with Zelle network operator Early Warning Services on a pilot that would connect the US instant-payment system with India's UPI network for NRI remittances.
nri-world.nri_angle: Millions of Indian professionals in the US remit money home monthly; a native Zelle-to-UPI channel would let them do it inside their banking app with faster settlement and lower cost.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Pooja Sethi Wins Primary, One Step from Historic Texas House Seat
nri-world.excerpt: The Indian American immigration attorney defeated a 20-year Army veteran for the Democratic nomination in Texas House District 47 and would be the first Indian American to serve in the Texas Legislature if she wins in November.
nri-world.image_caption: A "Pooja Sethi for Texas" campaign sign beside a portrait of Sethi. Sethi won the primary and is one step away from a historic Texas House seat.
nri-world.nri_angle: Sethi's run marks a milestone for Indian American political representation in Texas and shows how diaspora professionals are converting organizing and legislative staff work into electoral power.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Started at 12, Now 300,000 Strong: India's Children-Led Digital Art Museum
nri-world.excerpt: The Children's Art Museum of India, launched by two teenagers in 2022, has grown into a 300,000-member community of young artists — and it has never raised a rupee of investor funding.
nri-world.image_caption: A portrait of Krish Nawal, co-founder of the Children's Art Museum of India, set against a wall of framed children's paintings. CAMI has grown from a project started by two teenagers into a digital community of more than 300,000 members.
nri-world.nri_angle: Diaspora families can use CAMI as a bridge for their children to create art, take part in challenges, and learn about traditional Indian art forms from anywhere in the world.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-Origin Truck Driver Charged in Ohio Crash That Killed Woman, 50
nri-world.excerpt: Manjit Singh, 39, of Fresno, California, faces an aggravated vehicular homicide charge after a September 2 head-on collision on US 68; ICE has lodged a detainer as DHS ties the case to federal immigration policy.
nri-world.nri_angle: A fatal Ohio crash involving an Indian-origin truck driver has become the latest flashpoint in the national debate over immigration enforcement and commercial driver's license rules.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: "Talent Is Universal, Opportunity Is Not": Wadhwani Foundation CEO Dr. Ajay Kela on Why the Diaspora's Greatest Asset Isn't Money
nri-world.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with The Videshi, the CEO of Wadhwani Foundation talks about India's innovation ecosystem, the "missing middle" of Indian entrepreneurship, and why the diaspora's most powerful currency isn't capital — it's knowledge.
nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.
nri-world.nri_angle: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kela, NRI leader who returned to India to lead Wadhwani Foundation — covers diaspora giving back, deep-tech opportunities, and India's innovation ecosystem.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Indian man jailed 27 years in Australia for fatal stabbing, faces deportation
immigration.excerpt: Robin Robin, 30, was sentenced in the Victorian Supreme Court for murdering 22-year-old Navjeet Singh Sandhu and attempting to murder Sharwan Singh during a drunken rampage in Ormond in May 2024. He will not be eligible for parole for 20 years and is expected to be deported to India.
immigration.image_caption: Melbourne, where the Victorian Supreme Court sentenced Robin Robin to 27 years in prison for a fatal stabbing in Ormond.
immigration.nri_angle: The sentencing shows how a serious criminal conviction in Australia leads to visa cancellation and post-sentence deportation for Indian nationals, a direct warning for the large Indian student and migrant community.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: DHS Proposes $103,265 Fee on Every H-1B Cap Petition in Sweeping Rulemaking
immigration.excerpt: DHS says the fee would recover $8.8 billion a year in federal immigration costs. Unlike the struck-down $100,000 order, it would apply even to F-1 students changing status inside the U.S.
immigration.image_caption: The U.S. Capitol in Washington. The Department of Homeland Security has proposed a $103,265 fee on every H-1B cap petition.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian nationals receive the largest share of H-1B visas, so a six-figure fee would sharply raise employer costs for hiring Indian tech workers and could cool H-1B demand.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: September Visa Bulletin Brings Biggest Family Green Card Advances in Years
immigration.excerpt: Family-sponsored final action dates jumped by up to 29 months, with India gaining in F2B and F3 — but employment-based categories froze and India EB-2 stays unavailable.
immigration.image_caption: Immigration paperwork, including an Affidavit of Support form, an IRS account transcript, and a calculator on a desk. The State Department's September 2026 Visa Bulletin brought some of the largest forward movements in recent years across family-sponsored green card categories.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian family-sponsored applicants gain years of forward movement in F2B and F3, while Indian professionals in employment-based lines see no relief and face possible retrogression before October.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: DOL Suspends New PERM Green Card Filings by Cognizant, Cloudera
immigration.excerpt: The Labor Department's inspector general froze new permanent labor certification filings at the two tech firms amid a fraud probe — stalling green card sponsorships for thousands of H-1B workers, with no charges yet announced.
immigration.image_caption: TR Immigration social card image accompanying its report on the PERM filing suspensions. The Labor Department inspector general announced on September 8, 2026 that new permanent labor certification filings by Cognizant and Cloudera were frozen during a fraud investigation.
immigration.nri_angle: The freeze stalls green card sponsorships for thousands of Indian H-1B professionals at Cognizant and Cloudera, including the six-year extensions that depend on pending PERM or approved I-140 petitions.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Newly Discovered Canadian Citizenship: How to Sponsor Your Spouse for Permanent Residence
immigration.excerpt: Citizenship by descent follows bloodlines, not marriage — but as a Canadian citizen you can sponsor your spouse or partner for PR, leading eventually to citizenship.
immigration.image_caption: A couple reviews immigration paperwork at home, a Canadian flag on the wall. New guidance clarifies how newly discovered Canadian citizens can sponsor a spouse for permanent residence.
immigration.nri_angle: Many Indian-origin US families discover Canadian citizenship through a parent or grandparent, and spousal sponsorship can reshape their whole immigration strategy amid tightening US visa rules.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Indian Creator's Schengen Visa Rejected: The 3 Mistakes She Wants You to Avoid
immigration.excerpt: Garima Singh's rejection notice cited an unreliable itinerary, an uncertain purpose of stay and a name mismatch — three classic red flags behind India's 181,000 Schengen refusals last year.
immigration.image_caption: An open passport covered in visa stamps and entry markings. The image reflects the documentation pitfalls flagged by an Indian creator whose Schengen visa application was rejected.
immigration.nri_angle: Practical service journalism for Indian travellers planning Europe trips — and a cautionary tale for NRIs hosting family visits to the Schengen zone.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: 170,000 Salvadorans Face Uncertain Future as Trump Targets Their Protected Status
immigration.excerpt: Their Temporary Protected Status was set to expire September 9, but DHS has not announced a decision — leaving a community that has lived legally in the US for 25 years in limbo.
immigration.image_caption: A woman speaks during an interview at her home, where packed boxes are visible. Around 170,000 Salvadoran TPS holders are awaiting a Department of Homeland Security decision on their protections.
immigration.nri_angle: Indians are not a major TPS group, but the pattern matters: the administration is systematically dismantling humanitarian protections, and diaspora communities are watching how courts and Congress respond.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Trump Administration Moves to Scrap H-1B 60-Day Grace Period After Job Loss
immigration.excerpt: A DHS proposal published September 10 would require H-1B and other temporary workers to leave the U.S. as soon as employment ends - with Indian professionals the most exposed.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian nationals were about 71 percent of successful H-1B applicants in fiscal 2024, so eliminating the grace period would turn any tech layoff into an immediate departure order for Indian workers and their families.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: F-1 Fixed-Admission Rule Takes Effect September 15: What Indian Students Must Do
immigration.excerpt: A DHS final rule replaces decades-old duration-of-status admissions with a fixed 'admit until date' on the Form I-94 - after which students must extend their stay or depart.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian students and their families plan multi-year degrees around a stable immigration framework that now carries a hard expiration date - and any international travel after September 15 means readmission under the new fixed-date system.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada to Let Eligible Work Permit Holders Study Without a Study Permit
immigration.excerpt: IRCC's new temporary measure allows eligible foreign workers to take short-term courses without a separate study permit through December 31, 2027 — a practical boost for professionals upgrading skills while on the job.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian professionals are among the largest groups of temporary foreign workers in Canada, so a simpler path to short professional courses directly affects their career mobility.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: UK Warns Visa Applicants: Don't Book Travel Until Your Decision Arrives
immigration.excerpt: Home Office updates both processing-time pages to state UKVI will not cover travel costs if applications are refused or delayed.
immigration.image_caption: The GOV.UK portal. The Home Office updated its visa processing-time guidance on September 9, 2026, warning applicants not to book travel until they receive a decision.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian applicants are among the largest UK visa cohorts; the new wording puts the cost of premature travel bookings squarely on applicants.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Techies Still Rule H-1B Banking Hires as $100K Fee Reshapes Sponsorship
immigration.excerpt: Analysis of 17,500 filings shows engineers win nearly half of bank H-1Bs while front-office hires top $300k — as a new $100,000 application fee changes the maths.
immigration.image_caption: A chart of H-1B Labor Condition Applications by employer for 2023. Analysis of 17,500 filings shows technology staff win just under half of H-1B sponsorships at the five largest US banks.
immigration.nri_angle: Indians are the largest H-1B beneficiaries; the data shows tech skills remain the surest sponsorship route while the $100k fee squeezes entry-level analyst pipelines.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: EPF Withdrawal Rules: What EPFO's Simplified Advance Norms Mean for Your Savings
markets-finance.excerpt: Thirteen withdrawal provisions are now three categories, claims settle in three days, and auto-settlement rises to Rs 5 lakh — but a quarter of your corpus must stay put.
markets-finance.image_caption: An illustration of EPF services like balance details, claim status and passbook download alongside the EPFO building. EPFO has simplified its advance withdrawal norms, easing the process for members.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs holding EPF balances from earlier Indian employment fall under the same simplified rules — another reason to keep UAN-linked records current.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Adyen to Expand India Operations as Local Profits More Than Double
markets-finance.excerpt: The Dutch payments processor is betting on India's digital payments growth and rising cross-border commerce, with local headcount up tenfold since 2023 and pre-tax income at €3.18 million.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Adyen payments platform. The company plans to expand its India operations after local profits more than doubled.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Adyen's expansion supports cross-border payments for Indian businesses going global and multinationals entering India, a corridor that matters to diaspora-linked commerce.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Sensex Crashes 813 Points as $100 Oil and West Asia Tensions Rattle Markets
markets-finance.excerpt: The benchmark fell for a third straight session to 74,764 as Brent crude topped $100 and IT stocks led a broad selloff; India VIX jumped over 6%.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The BSE Sensex crashed 813 points on Wednesday as crude oil topped $100 a barrel amid escalating West Asia tensions.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs with India equity exposure face a triple hit: falling stock prices, a weakening rupee and $100 crude squeezing corporate margins.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Rupee Slumps to 95.08 as Crude Tops $100 on US-Iran Escalation
markets-finance.excerpt: The currency fell 34 paise in a single session as Brent crude breached $100 for the first time in six weeks; analysts see a negative bias ahead.
markets-finance.image_caption: A large rupee symbol installation set against a living green wall. The Indian currency slumped 34 paise to close at 95.08 against the US dollar on Wednesday as crude oil breached $100 a barrel.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A weaker rupee means remittances buy more back home, but it also fuels the inflation that erodes real returns on NRI deposits and India portfolios.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Adani Eyes Overseas Airports, Joins Catania Bidders as $1 Billion Fundraise Closes
markets-finance.excerpt: The Financial Times reports the Adani Group is planning an international airports push; Reuters has reported the group is among the bidders for Sicily's Catania airport, as a $1 billion fundraise values Adani Airport Holdings at $18 billion.
markets-finance.image_caption: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani. Adani Airports is bidding for overseas airports as it builds a $1 billion fund.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors and travellers, a global Adani airports network would put an Indian operator on the flight paths many NRIs travel.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Divyanshi Choudhary Breaks Down After Last-Minute Asian Games Wushu Axing
sports.excerpt: The 18-year-old wushu player beat Roshibina Devi in the selection trials and had already collected her India kit for Aichi-Nagoya — then was dropped days before departure, citing a knee injury her camp calls treatable.
sports.image_caption: A wushu competition. Divyanshi Choudhary broke down after her event was axed from the Asian Games at the last minute.
sports.nri_angle: Selection transparency and athlete welfare in Indian sports — a governance issue diaspora fans follow closely as India chases medals beyond cricket at the Asian Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Anmol Ekka Double Fires India Into Fourth Straight Junior Asia Cup Final
sports.excerpt: India beat Malaysia 3-1 in Moqi, China, with captain Ekka scoring twice and goalkeeper Vivek Lakra saving a penalty stroke; South Korea await in Sunday's final.
sports.image_caption: India's junior men's hockey team in action. Anmol Ekka's double fired the defending champions into a fourth straight Junior Asia Cup final.
sports.nri_angle: Anmol Ekka's 16-goal breakout gives diaspora hockey fans a new star to follow as India's junior pipeline builds toward the Junior World Cup.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India's New Zealand Tour Sells 50,000 Tickets in Two Weeks
sports.excerpt: NZ Cricket sold more than 50,000 tickets in just over two weeks for India's first tour in six years, reopening Eden Park's sixth tier for the first time since 2019.
sports.image_caption: A packed cricket stadium under lights during a night match. Tickets for India's tour of New Zealand sold 50,000 seats within two weeks.
sports.nri_angle: India fixtures draw the largest and loudest diaspora crowds of any touring side in New Zealand, home to one of the world's fastest-growing Indian communities.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Kuldeep Yadav's Career-Best Ten-For Powers Yorkshire to Innings Win Over Essex
sports.excerpt: The India wrist-spinner's 10 for 120 — his first ten-wicket haul in first-class cricket — sank Essex twice at Headingley and all but sealed Yorkshire's Division One survival.
sports.image_caption: Kuldeep Yadav during a visit to the Prime Minister's Office in New Delhi. Yadav took a career-best ten-wicket haul for Yorkshire in their innings win over Essex.
sports.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans in England watched a home hero dominate at Headingley, and Kuldeep's county form is being closely tracked in India ahead of future tours.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Shami Breaks Silence on India Absence, Sets Sights on Comeback
sports.excerpt: Marking his 100th first-class match with a Duleep Trophy title, the 36-year-old pacer says his eyes are on the "next level" — as selectors insist they stayed in touch through his England-tour absence.
sports.image_caption: Mohammed Shami after receiving the Arjuna Award. Shami has broken his silence on his absence from the India squad and says he is targeting a comeback.
sports.nri_angle: Indian diaspora cricket fans and US club/community players follow Shami's comeback push as the national team's most decorated active quick.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: New Zealand Captain Santner Turns Down Big BBL Deal to Lead Against India
sports.excerpt: The 34-year-old rejected a two-year Adelaide Strikers offer to keep his New Zealand central contract and white-ball captaincy ahead of the India home series.
sports.nri_angle: The India vs New Zealand home series is the marquee event Santner prioritised — directly relevant to the Indian cricket diaspora, which follows the fixture intensely.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Women's Spinners Bundle Pakistan Out for 55 in Asia Cup Rout
sports.excerpt: Left-arm spinner Shree Charani's 3 for 7 led a spin masterclass in Dubai, and Harmanpreet Kaur sealed a seven-wicket win in 8.4 overs in her 150th T20I as captain.
sports.nri_angle: India-Pakistan cricket is appointment viewing for the South Asian diaspora, and this rout gave fans across the US, Canada, UK and the Gulf a night to savour.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Tanya Chaudhary Smashes National Hammer Throw Record Days Before Asian Games
sports.excerpt: The Uttar Pradesh athlete sent the hammer to 68.35m at the Indian Athletics Series Final on Thursday, breaking 18-year-old Anushka Yadav's record with the Aichi-Nagoya Games beginning September 19.
sports.nri_angle: India's rising women's hammer throw, led by Chaudhary and Yadav, gives diaspora track fans a genuine medal hope at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Georgia Teen Anannya Aneesh Earns Spot at 2027 U19 Women's World Cup
sports.excerpt: The Mountain View High School senior helped the USA Women's U19 team sweep the Americas Qualifier to reach the 2027 ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup.
sports.nri_angle: Aneesh's arc — falling in love with cricket through the IPL with her father in Georgia, representing the USA, and planning to play in India — runs the full arc of the diaspora cricket dream.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Rout Pakistan 19-0 to Storm Into Junior Women's Hockey Asia Cup Semis
sports.excerpt: India's junior women thrashed Pakistan 19-0 in their Women's Junior Asia Cup quarterfinal in Moqi, China — Pooja Malik hit a hat-trick and the defending champions, now two wins from a third straight continental title, face the South Korea-Malaysia winner in the semifinals.
sports.image_caption: Action from the India-Pakistan match at the Women's Junior Asia Cup in Moqi, China. India won the quarterfinal 19-0 to storm into the semifinals.
sports.nri_angle: For diaspora families whose kids play field hockey in US and Canadian leagues, this junior side — defending champions now two wins from a three-peat — is the next generation to watch, with several of these names likely to step into the senior India squad within a year or two.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Antim Panghal Confident as India Targets Wrestling Gold at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: The women's 53kg wrestler says a senior-junior mix, three months of joint training and a Japanese coach have the squad ready for Aichi-Nagoya.
sports.image_caption: Two wrestlers grapple on the mat during a bout. Antim Panghal heads into the Asian Games as one of India’s leading medal hopes in wrestling.
sports.nri_angle: The Asian Games are a marquee quadrennial event for the diaspora's sporting calendar, and wrestling remains one of the disciplines where Indian fans abroad expect podium finishes.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Firm Favourites as Bangladesh Eye Upset in Women's Asia Cup Semi-Final
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's unbeaten side meet Bangladesh in Dubai on Thursday, chasing a record-extending eighth Asia Cup title.
sports.image_caption: Players from India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Pakistan in a Women’s Asia Cup 2026 semi-final graphic. India face Bangladesh in the last-four clash.
sports.nri_angle: The 8 PM IST start (7:30 AM Pacific) makes this a morning watch for the US diaspora, with SonyLIV and Sony Max carrying the game for Indian fans abroad.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Trezor Brevo Breach Exposed 347,000 Emails to Phishing Attack
technology.excerpt: A flaw in email provider Brevo's login system let attackers send phishing emails from Trezor's own domain to 347,000 newsletter subscribers — the hardware wallet maker's second third-party data breach in weeks.
technology.nri_angle: Crypto ownership runs deep in the Indian diaspora, so wallet-holding readers should scrutinize vendor-branded emails and warn family members about the phishing campaign.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: The AI 'Doomsday' Debate Moves From Silicon Valley to Mainstream America
technology.excerpt: A departing Anthropic researcher's warning about civilization-ending AI has triggered the week's biggest tech story — and new calls in Congress for guardrails.
technology.image_caption: A data center housing AI infrastructure. The debate over catastrophic AI risk has moved from Silicon Valley circles into mainstream American discourse.
technology.nri_angle: Indian engineers form a large share of the AI research workforce, so both a regulatory crackdown and unchecked deployment would land directly on diaspora careers.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: TCS Opens India's First Lights-Out Factory Lab in Pune for AI Manufacturing
technology.excerpt: The Industrial Autonomy & Engineering Lab features a fully robotic battery pack assembly line where manufacturers can prototype AI-first production systems before deploying them in real factories.
technology.image_caption: A robotic arm works on an automated factory production line. TCS launched its Industrial Autonomy & Engineering Lab, described as India's first lights-out factory lab for AI-led manufacturing, at its Pune campus on September 9.
technology.nri_angle: The lab advances India's positioning in AI-led manufacturing, a sector diaspora investors and tech professionals watch as a signal of where global industrial AI work is heading.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Jio Payment Solutions Launches Cross-Border Platform for Indian Exporters
technology.excerpt: The Jio Financial Services unit won RBI authorization to operate as a cross-border payment aggregator, offering multi-currency virtual accounts that let exporters skip SWIFT and correspondent banking.
technology.image_caption: The Jio logo. Jio Payment Solutions has launched a cross-border payments platform aimed at Indian exporters.
technology.nri_angle: Diaspora entrepreneurs and freelance professionals doing business with India gain a regulated, lower-friction rail for getting paid across borders.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Anthropic Researcher Quits, Says AI Labs Are 'Gambling With Our Lives'
technology.excerpt: Jacob Coxon, who did pretraining research at both OpenAI and Anthropic, resigned warning that frontier labs are racing to self-improving superintelligence — and was publicly backed by Anthropic's own alignment science lead.
technology.image_caption: A robotic hand hovers over a keyboard in front of a blurred Anthropic logo in a Reuters illustration. AI researcher Jacob Coxon resigned from Anthropic on September 9, 2026, warning that frontier labs were "gambling with our lives" in the race to superintelligence.
technology.nri_angle: Indian engineers and researchers inside frontier AI labs are central to the technology — and the safety debate Coxon ignited affects the industry many diaspora professionals work in.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India Launches UPI Tap-and-Pay Ahead of Full Apple Pay Rollout
technology.excerpt: The NFC-based UPI feature works even without a network connection and lands weeks before Apple's expected full India launch — while NPCI quietly prepares AI agents that can pay on your behalf.
technology.image_caption: The UPI logo. India has launched UPI tap-and-pay ahead of a full Apple Pay rollout.
technology.nri_angle: Tap-enabled UPI plus an October Apple Pay launch make paying in India far easier for NRIs visiting home, potentially matching the tap convenience they have abroad.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Nilekani: Tokenisation's Time Has Come — And India Needs Public Chains
technology.excerpt: At the Global Fintech Fest 2026, the Aadhaar architect argued that land, gold and corporate bonds should move to tokenised rails on public blockchains — paired with AI agents that shop for credit 24/7.
technology.image_caption: Nandan Nilekani speaks at a World Economic Forum session. The Infosys co-founder argues tokenisation's time has come and India needs public blockchains for the next wave of digital assets.
technology.nri_angle: Nilekani's digital-public-infrastructure thinking (Aadhaar, UPI) is closely followed by the global fintech diaspora; tokenised-asset markets could eventually open new investment rails for NRIs.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: PhonePe's Rahul Chari Charts AI Push for India's Next 300 Million Users
technology.excerpt: The PhonePe co-founder says AI will increase feature velocity and enterprise value as the fintech moves to bring vernacular, privacy-first AI to 300 million first-time digital users.
technology.nri_angle: NRIs managing family finances through PhonePe get a window into how AI will reach India's next wave of first-time digital users, a playbook the global fintech industry is watching.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Accenture, Google Cloud Launch Unit Deploying 1,000 AI Engineers On-Site
technology.excerpt: Google Cloud will train up to 1,000 Accenture engineers to work inside client offices building AI applications — the industry's latest bet that embedded, forward-deployed talent is the key to AI returns.
technology.image_caption: The Google Cloud logo on display. Accenture and Google Cloud have formed the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, which will train up to 1,000 engineers to deploy agentic AI inside client offices.
technology.nri_angle: Accenture's large Indian-origin workforce and India's global capability centers sit at the center of the enterprise AI deployment wave this new unit aims to staff.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: PhonePe Becomes First Indian App to Offer Visa's Full Tokenisation Suite
technology.excerpt: Tap to Pay, Cross Border Scan to Pay and Smart Accept debut at the Global Fintech Fest, extending the card network's tokenisation push on India's largest payments app.
technology.nri_angle: Cross Border Scan to Pay across 14 Asian markets directly serves Indian travellers and NRIs who move between India and the region.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: PhonePe Wins UAE Central Bank Licence for First-Ever Foreign Foray
technology.excerpt: Founder Sameer Nigam says the fintech will launch a local wallet, gift cards, diaspora remittances and merchant acquiring in the Emirates — and aims to be "a global business" within a decade.
technology.image_caption: PhonePe branding pictured in an Economic Times illustration. The fintech has received a Central Bank of the UAE licence to launch operations in the Emirates, its first market outside India.
technology.nri_angle: The UAE hosts one of the world's largest Indian expatriate communities, and PhonePe's wallet and remittance services are aimed squarely at diaspora money flows.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google Commits Record $15 Billion to Finland AI Infrastructure in Largest European Bet
technology.excerpt: The tech giant's biggest single European investment includes data centres, a 22-year nuclear power deal with Fortum, and grid upgrades — turning Finland into the 'Texas of Europe' for AI.
technology.nri_angle: Google's massive Finland AI investment signals sustained demand for Indian tech talent and services across Europe's expanding data centre corridor.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Mirzapur The Movie Crosses $2 Million In North America, Climbing Indian Box Office Charts
entertainment.excerpt: The crime thriller took ₹9.5 crore on its second Friday to reach ₹163.27 crore net in India, overtaking Awarapan 2 for the year's No. 6 spot, while its $2.05 million North American haul made it the fourth Bollywood film of 2026 to cross $2 million in the territory.
entertainment.nri_angle: Mirzapur The Movie's $2.05 million North American first week — Bollywood's fourth $2M grosser of 2026 — shows how diaspora demand for established Indian series IPs converts directly into overseas box office.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Sardar 2 opens at Rs 5.30 crore, loses domestic battle to Soori's Mandaadi
entertainment.excerpt: Karthi's Sardar 2 grossed Rs 5.30 crore in India on opening day but was out-earned at home by the much smaller Soori-starrer Mandaadi, which managed Rs 5.55 crore on nearly 1,000 fewer shows. Overseas business gave the sequel a narrow worldwide lead.
entertainment.image_caption: Karthi, who stars in Sardar 2. The film opened at Rs 5.30 crore domestically, trailing Soori's Mandaadi in its first week.
entertainment.nri_angle: Overseas business was the one front where Sardar 2 led on day one, with Tamil diaspora audiences in the Gulf, Malaysia and Singapore turning out for Karthi's sequel.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Toxic week 2: Yash's film crawls to Rs 263 crore as 300-crore flop looms
entertainment.excerpt: Yash's Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups added just Rs 6.75 crore in its second weekend, taking its 12-day India gross to Rs 263 crore. Trade trackers say the costly film is headed for one of the biggest losses in Indian cinema.
entertainment.image_caption: A still from Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, showing Yash and Kiara Advani. The Geethu Mohandas-directed film reached Rs 263 crore gross in India after 12 days and is expected to finish its run under Rs 270 crore.
entertainment.nri_angle: The film's English version, aimed partly at overseas multiplex audiences, was pulled after a week, and the theatrical collapse leaves the digital premiere as diaspora viewers' main route to the film.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Don't Be Shy trailer drops: Alia Bhatt's coming-of-age rom-com bets on fresh faces
entertainment.excerpt: The first trailer for Prime Video's Don't Be Shy introduces four debutant leads headed by Aarushi Bajaj, as producers Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt back a young-adult story of first love, friendship and messy choices ahead of its September 25 premiere.
entertainment.image_caption: A collage of the four young leads of Don't Be Shy alongside producers Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt. The coming-of-age romantic comedy premieres on Prime Video on September 25, 2026.
entertainment.nri_angle: The September 25 day-and-date Prime Video release across 240+ countries brings the film to diaspora living rooms worldwide at the same time as India.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: From Mardaani to Delhi Crime: Hindi Cinema's Women Cops Take Charge

entertainment.excerpt: Warned that Danny Boyle might throw out his score, Rahman composed the Slumdog Millionaire music in secret over three weeks — and collected two Oscars, two Grammys, a Golden Globe and a BAFTA.

entertainment.title: Rani Mukerji Accepts Raj Kapoor Award in Marathi, Marks Three Decades in Cinema

lifestyle-health.title: Drooping smile, weak arms: neurologists flag stroke warning signs in young adults
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A drooping smile, a weak arm and slurred speech are the classic red flags — and with four in ten Indian stroke patients now under 50, neurologists say young adults should learn the BEFAST checklist and act within the golden hours.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Brain scans. Neurologists warn that a drooping smile, weak arms, and slurred speech can signal a stroke.

lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians develop cardiovascular risk factors earlier and at higher rates, making BEFAST stroke awareness especially relevant in NRI households — and for spotting warning signs in ageing parents back home.

lifestyle-health.title: Inside Krystle D'Souza's Mumbai Home: Parisian Chic, a Glam Room and Sabyasachi Walls
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The Traitors season 2 winner gave Farah Khan a tour of her self-designed Lokhandwala apartment — from a ₹35,000-a-roll Sabyasachi bedroom wall to a bedroom-sized vanity room.

lifestyle-health.title: Paying Extra for A2 Ghee? Cardiologist Says the Label Is a Fad
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Dr. Darshan Banker and the IFBA's Deepak Jolly say the A1/A2 protein distinction is irrelevant in ghee, which is 99.9% fat — portion size and verified purity matter far more.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A bowl of homemade ghee in Maharashtra. A cardiologist says the premium A2 ghee label is more marketing fad than medicine.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: A2 ghee sells at double or triple the price in diaspora grocery stores on imported health claims that these experts say don't survive scrutiny.

lifestyle-health.title: How PCOS, Obesity and Insulin Resistance Lock Women in a Vicious Cycle
lifestyle-health.excerpt: About two-thirds of women with PCOS have insulin resistance — and each side of the triangle intensifies the other two. Doctors say treating the condition as a metabolic disorder, not just a fertility problem, is the way out.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: PCOS runs high among Indian women and the diaspora, and South Asians develop insulin resistance at lower body weights, making early metabolic screening — not just fertility treatment — especially urgent.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: DNA Hairpin Treatment Cuts Bad Cholesterol Nearly 50% Without Statins
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Scientists in Spain and the United States built short DNA molecules that switch off a cholesterol-regulating gene, cutting blood cholesterol 47% in mice after a single injection — with none of the side effects linked to statins.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A researcher at the National Human Genome Research Institute pipettes DNA from a micro test tube. Scientists used DNA-based polypurine hairpins to block production of the PCSK9 protein, cutting LDL cholesterol nearly 50% in a new study.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face disproportionately high rates of premature heart disease, so a cheaper, non-statin cholesterol treatment could matter greatly for the diaspora if it survives clinical testing.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Myntra Tech Threads 2026: Where AI, Velocity and Indian Fashion Collide
lifestyle-health.excerpt: At its Bengaluru conclave, Myntra pitched conversational discovery, creator-led shopping and an AI brand stack — arguing Indian fashion is now built in real time, not handed down from runways.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: The Myntra Tech Threads 2026 branding with its 'Where Velocity Meets Voice' tagline. The showcase brings together AI, technology and Indian fashion.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Ethnicwear was a strong awards and runway strand (Biba, House of Pataudi, Taavi) — contemporary Indian occasion wear the diaspora increasingly shops; the honoured homegrown D2C labels are ones diaspora readers seek out.

lifestyle-health.title: Sadhguru on Amavasya: Why Tonight's New Moon Is Spiritually Significant
lifestyle-health.excerpt: September's Amavasya tithi runs tonight into tomorrow morning. Sadhguru explains why the moon's absence makes its presence more powerful — and why the new moon suits the hardworking and tough.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Sadhguru sits with folded hands against a dark night sky with the moon visible. He teaches that on Amavasya, the new moon night, the moon's absence makes its presence felt more powerfully.

lifestyle-health.title: Former SBI Manager Quits Over Burnout, Opens Yoga Studio in UP
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A woman working as an assistant manager at the State Bank of India has quit her job, citing constant stress and mental exhaustion, and opened her own yoga studio in Uttar Pradesh — a story picked up by five national outlets that has become one of the week's most-shared conversations about work and wellbeing.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian professionals abroad — where banking, consulting and tech jobs carry the same grind — are having the same conversation about burnout and exit plans; this story lands because the trade-off between a secure job and mental health translates across borders.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Fortis and Takeda Launch 'Mission Dengue Free India' Awareness Campaign
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The nationwide initiative pairs physician-led community sessions with digital outreach to tackle a disease that officially struck over 113,000 Indians in 2025.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A mosquito feeds on human skin. Fortis Healthcare and Takeda have launched a ‘Mission Dengue Free India’ awareness campaign as mosquito-borne infections rise.

food.title: Mumbai's Lalbaugcha Raja Food Waste to Power Civic Hospitals During Ganeshotsav
food.excerpt: Under BMC's 'Prasad to Power' plan, 8–10 tonnes of wet waste from Mumbai's most famous Ganesh pandal will be converted into electricity for municipal hospitals across the 11-day festival.
food.image_caption: Mumbai's Lalbaugcha Raja Ganesh idol. Food waste collected during the festival will power civic hospitals.
food.nri_angle: The initiative pairs faith with sustainability at one of the diaspora's most-watched festivals, giving NRIs who follow Ganeshotsav from Mumbai's celebrations a tangible example of Indian cities linking devotion to environmental responsibility.

food.title: Microlot coffee: Inside India's limited-edition world of specialty brews
food.excerpt: From Tata Coffee's Nullore Estate at the Starbucks Reserve Roastery to yeast-washed lots from Ratnagiri, India's microlots — tiny, experimental, estate-separated batches — are winning global awards and selling out in small runs.

food.title: MasterChef's Jyoti Vishnani on Building an Indian Kitchen Under ₹10,000
food.excerpt: The MasterChef India Season 4 contestant says a great Indian kitchen comes down to ingredients, technique and wisely chosen tools — not expensive gadgets.
food.image_caption: Chef Jyoti Vishnani in her kitchen. The MasterChef contestant shares how to build an Indian kitchen for under ₹10,000.
food.nri_angle: NRIs setting up first kitchens abroad can build the same starter kit — pressure cooker, kadhai, tawa, masala dabba — for a fraction of a month's eating-out budget.

food.title: Which Roti Wins on Protein, Fibre, Iron and Calcium? Nutritionist's Answer

food.nri_angle: Colourism travels with the diaspora, showing up in casting, workplaces and South Asian grocery aisles abroad; the chef's calm, factual rebuttal resonates across borders.

food.title: In Bengal, Non-Veg Is Not a Treat During Durga Puja — It Is Bhog
food.excerpt: For Bengali families, mutton and hilsa offered to the Goddess on Navami are sacred prasad — a Shakta tradition that stands apart from North India's vegetarian Navratri.

food.title: Sri Lankan-Style Coconut Kheema: A Creamy 350-Calorie Weeknight Dinner Fix

food.title: Sabudana Kheer: The Creamy Fasting Dessert That Needs No Soaking

food.image_caption: A bowl of sabudana kheer, the creamy tapioca-pearl dessert eaten during fasting days.
